title: Prime localizations of a unique factorization domain are UFDs
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative unique factorization domain, meaning an integral domain in which each nonzero nonunit factors into prime elements uniquely up to order and unit factors. For every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset A$, the localization $A_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is an integral domain with the same unique factorization property.

source.place: Tag 0BD8, lemma-closure-effective-cartier-divisor, proof sentence: "Then all local rings of A are UFD's." This is the localization input, stated independently of any divisor.
